entities.title: zazzled proxy options
entities.summary: Command-line options of `zazzled proxy`: how texts are cleaned, which tools are left alone, a file of per-tool settings, logging, and where the server is.
entities.key: --lossless, --budget T, --skip TOOL, --config FILE, --log, -- CMD ARGS.., --upstream URL, --listen ADDR
entities.type: flags; integer (tokens); string (repeatable); path; command line; URL; socket address
entities.default: lossy cleaning; --budget 8000; no tools skipped; no config file; no log; --listen 127.0.0.1:8808 with --upstream
entities.validation: Exactly one of `-- CMD ARGS..` (non-empty, without --listen) or --upstream must be given; --budget must be a number of at least 1; --upstream must start with http:// or https://; a --config file that cannot be read or is not valid stops the proxy (proxy-config-file); an unknown option is refused with the usage line.

entities.title: zazzled proxy --config FILE
entities.summary: A JSON file of per-tool settings: for each tool (by exact name, else the longest matching `*` pattern) and for resource reads, whether to clean losslessly, the budget per text, and whether to leave the answer alone.
entities.key: --config FILE: {"tools": {NAME_OR_PATTERN: RULE, ..}, "resources": RULE}, where RULE has lossless (true or false), budget (a number of at least 1) and skip (true or false)
entities.default: no file: every answer uses the command line's --lossless, --budget and --skip
entities.scope: One proxy process. A setting a rule leaves out comes from the command line; a tool named with --skip is skipped whatever its rule says.
entities.validation: Read once when the options are parsed. Text that is not JSON, a top level that is not an object, a section other than tools and resources, a setting other than lossless, budget and skip, a flag that is not true or false, or a budget that is not a number of at least 1 stops the proxy with `--config FILE: ...` naming the place, exit 2.

entities.title: Output store for shortened texts
entities.summary: The proxy stores each text it shortens, with the original, in the output store it finds at start: ZAZZLE_OUTPUTS_DIR, else ~/.zazzle/outputs.
entities.scope: One proxy process: the directory is read when the options are parsed, the size limit on each save. Their meaning is owned by macos/rust/zazzled/src (configuration.json).
entities.validation: Without a directory nothing is stored and no id items are added; a save that fails adds `[shortened by zazzle; not stored for read-again: ...]` instead.

entities.title: Proxy environment variables for the upstream
entities.summary: In HTTP mode the upstream client honours the environment's proxy settings, such as HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY.
entities.key: HTTPS_PROXY, NO_PROXY (and the other proxy variables the ureq crate reads)
entities.scope: Connections from `zazzled proxy --upstream` to the upstream URL.
entities.details: http.rs builds its client with the library's environment proxy lookup left on (agent(true)); which variables are read, and how, is the ureq crate's behaviour and was not checked here. A proxy URL may carry credentials; it is the user's own setting and is never logged by the proxy.
